## About
RHD Primary Plumbing is family owned and operated here in Lewisville. We focus on residential repair plumbing so we can do our best on every service call, whether it's a simple faucet installation or a sewer line unstop.
Robert's mission is to show Southern Denton County a new breed of plumber: friendly, courteous and honest about what you need. We're not about selling you products you don't need, and we're glad to explain our pricing over the phone.
Customers often meet Robert and his wife Karen, who work together on jobs. We take Sundays off to enjoy time at church and with our families. Neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 178 Google reviews.

## Services
- Sinks, drains and faucets: Repairs and installations for kitchen and bath sinks, drains, and indoor or outdoor faucets.
- Toilets: Toilet repairs and replacements, done carefully and cleaned up after.
- Garbage disposals: Garbage disposal installation and repair.
- Ground floor water heaters: Repair and replacement for water heaters located on the ground floor.
- Leaks and clogs: Finding and fixing leaks and clearing clogged lines around the house.
- Hydro-jetting: Hydro-jetting for lines up to 4 inch pipe.
- Video sewer inspections: A camera look inside your sewer line to see what's going on.
- Slab leak referrals: If you have a slab leak, we can refer you to the right help.

## FAQ
Q: Is there a special discount for seniors, veterans and disabled individuals?
A: Yes. Call and ask about our special discount for seniors, veterans and disabled individuals.

Q: Can you tell me about pricing before you come out?
A: We're happy to answer your questions and explain our pricing over the phone.

Q: Do you work on commercial buildings?
A: We focus primarily on residential plumbing so we can do our best on every home service call.
